messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: `SYNTH_CANARY_FAILURE` — probe 'canary-eu-1' failed 3x in 5m, page fired to oncall. details: https://rwd-incidents.example/PD/INC12345

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty alert -> Triggered: INC12345; Escalation level 1 -> oncall (Maya).

Maya: acked on pagerduty :white_check_mark: I'll take first response. anyone seeing errors in prod?

Liam: seeing a spike in synthetic failures in eu-west. quick check: `curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code} %{time_total}
' https://canary-eu-1.rwd-infer.test/health` returns `504 30.12`.

Sanjay: @Maya routing/control plane? or prober backend?

Zoe: prober logs show timeouts to model router 10.12.5.8: `dial tcp 10.12.5.8:443: i/o timeout` starting 1718209400. 3 hosts in eu pool show similar.

Maya: checking console dashboards — latency for model-router-eu jumped at 12:03 UTC, error budget alert didn't fire yet but canary is unhappy.

ops-oncall: just saw PD highlighted that prober fanout increased after config change last night. cc @SRE oncall.

Maya: important q: customer-facing requests impacted? from quick traces, real user traffic to hosted API in eu is fine — 200 rate steady. seems isolated to synth canary path (prober -> internal router).

Liam: root cause hypothesis: prober fanout retries saturating a small subset of model-router instances causing transient timeouts. I can tail the prober pod logs.

Zoe: pasted logs (trimmed):
```
2026-03-14T12:02:48Z prober service request id=abc123 to 10.12.5.8 attempt=1 timeout=15s
2026-03-14T12:02:49Z prober request id=abc123 attempt=2 timeout=15s
2026-03-14T12:02:51Z prober giving up id=abc123 status=504
```

Sanjay: any recent deploys to model-router-eu? I see a canary rollout at 2026-03-14T00:45 but it passed smoke.

Maya: ok immediate mitigation: reduce prober parallelism and disable aggressive retries. ops-oncall, can you patch prober config to single-threaded for eu region and lower retries to 1? runbook ref: /runbooks/synth-probes.md

ops-oncall: on it — applying config patch now (kubectl apply -f prober-eu-reduce-parallel.yaml).

ops-oncall: patch applied. prober pods restarting.

Liam: after restart, first probe results: `200 0.23` for canary-eu-1. latency back to normal.

Zoe: verifying model-router health: 3 instances had high FD util, freed after prober throttle. no further `i/o timeout` in last 5m.

Maya: good. I'm going to escalate to PD to note this as acknowledged and suppressed for the synth check.

pagerduty-bot: Alert INC12345 acknowledged by Maya; suppression window set for 30m for `SYNTH_CANARY_FAILURE` in eu region.

Sanjay: customer impact summary for postmortem: - Scope: synthetic canary failures only, no customer-facing API errors observed. - Duration: 12:02 UTC -> 12:10 UTC (mitigation applied). - Root cause: prober fanout + retries overloaded subset of model-router instances causing timeouts. - Mitigation: throttled prober, reduced retries, restarted prober pods.

Maya: filing incident report & follow-up actions: 1) add guardrails to prober to stop retrying on connection errors, 2) add queue/backpressure on model-router side, 3) revert prober config change that caused burst in next deploy window and add canary for prober config. I'll create the ticket and link here.

Maya: created INC-POST-6789 with details and action items. linking: https://rwd-incidents.example/INC-POST-6789

Zoe: leaving note: if we see canary failing but prod OK, suppress PD for 15m automatically and notify SRE via channel before page. task for Optimize team.

Maya: thanks team. closing PD ticket in 10m if no regression.

incident-bot: PD INC12345 auto-closed (suppressed) by Maya after ack; follow-up incident created INC-POST-6789. For urgent ops ping @ops-oncall.

Liam: quick reminder to run the prober config validation job before next prod change. :thumbsup:

Sanjay: noted. I'll add validation to CI.

Maya: end of thread — monitoring 30m. :white_check_mark:
